support_diagnostic.chi_derivation: For A0=L L^T and U_H spanning H feature columns, floor=||(I-P_span(L^-1 U_H)) L^-1 b||^2. This equals b^T A0^-1 b-q^T(U_H^T A0^-1 U_H)^+q. Apply literal native/source unit conversion.
support_diagnostic.chi_interpretation: Optimistic lower limit allowing arbitrary PSD stiffness of unbounded size over U_H, a superset of the declared coefficient family. It is also an infimum bound for any stable supported symmetric update by block elimination. No finite coefficient attaining the limit is asserted.
support_diagnostic.mu_derivation: m=(u+v)/2; A0(m-m0)=h-Hm. Therefore delta_mu lies in range(B^T A0^-1 U_mu), U_mu=span(U_H,h features). Orthogonal target residual cannot be removed by any coefficients confined to this support, even unbounded.
support_diagnostic.near_collinearity: Actual radial and frame vectors may be nearly collinear from rounded source coordinates. Inspect all singular values/cutoffs. Full oxygen Cartesian support is a more permissive check independent of these near-collinear frame directions; do not infer strict impossibility solely from a suppressed near-null vector.
support_diagnostic.scope: Ordinary-double geometric support calculation with reported SVD ranks, not a rigorous interval certificate or a quantum mechanism assignment. Raw reference/method/printing limitations remain. All targets consumed; no model refit or new acceptance threshold.

Water full coordinate forces are unavailable from these frozen-operator predictions; no force preservation, periodic dynamics or production qualification follows.
